receive.title: Receive
receive.intro: Enter this address to receive XLM or Token in this account.
receive.noAccount: First, add an account at the top. Then you'll see its address and the QR code here.
receive.testnet: You are in Testnet. Balances on Testnet have no value.
receive.hintCompare: Have the sender check the first and last 8 characters of the address, shown in bold. Scammers deliberately use addresses that look similar at the start and end.
receive.hintTrustline: You can only receive Tokens other than XLM once you have a Token authorization (Trustline) for them.
receive.hintActivate: A new account is activated only after an initial deposit of at least 1 XLM.
receive.hintMuxed: Payments sent to an M-address are deposited into your base account and are marked with the Muxed ID. Not every Wallet or exchange supports M-addresses.

activity.title: Last Activity
activity.loadError: The activity could not be loaded.
activity.lookalikeHint: This address starts and ends just like an address you've sent to, but it's a different one. Never copy recipients from your history.
activity.lookalikeWarning: Warning: At least one sender resembles an address you've sent to before. Never copy recipients from your history; always copy them from a trusted source.
activity.memoHint: Memo from the sender. Content not verified by SKM.
activity.onlyDust: Only very small payments are available.
activity.urlHint: The Memo contains a web address. This is not necessary for making a payment. Do not open the link.
activity.fakeNativeHint: This is a Token from a publisher, not the network's native XLM.

claimable.title: Claimable Balances
claimable.intro: Payments that are available for your account but must be cleared before they appear in your balance.
claimable.withTrustline: When redeemed, creates a Trustline for {{code}}.
claimable.noTrustNote: There is no Trustline for this Assets. Redeeming it creates one and locks 0.5 XLM in reserve. You can find information about Token in the Token search.
claimable.truncated: Only the first {{count}} entries are displayed.
claimable.loadError: Claimable balances could not be loaded.
claimable.insufficientReserve: Trustline requires {{reserve}} XLM in reserve; {{available}} XLM is available.
claimable.insufficientWeight: The Signers you entered do not collectively meet the required weight of {{required}}.
claimable.ambiguous: The result is unclear (Netzwerkfehler). Please check the transaction {{hash}} in the explorer before trying again.
claimable.networkMismatch: The Horizon server is not part of the selected network. Nothing was signed or sent.
claimable.insufficientWeightJob: The Signers you entered do not collectively meet the required weight {{required}}. Instead, prepare a Multisig job, and then the other Signers can sign on the website.
claimable.tooLittleTime: The claimable balance will expire too soon to be redeemed as a Multisig job.
claimable.jobHint: The Claimable Balance may expire or be redeemed in some other way before everyone has signed. The job will then fail upon submission. If it fails only in the ledger, the fee is consumed; otherwise, nothing changes. The job’s validity is limited so that it does not extend beyond the end of its redeemability period.

blocked.trustlineNotAuthorized: Your Trustline for this Asset has not been approved by the publisher.
blocked.trustlineLimit: Your Trustline limit is not sufficient for this amount.

batchConvert.title: Batch-Convert
batchConvert.intro: Redems multiple Claimable Balances at once and converts them into a target Asset of your choice. Any missing Trustlines are briefly created for this purpose and then deleted in the same transaction; only the target Asset remains in the account.
batchConvert.targetNote: XLM is preselected because it is the native Asset. This is not a recommendation. SKM does not evaluate Token; check the facts about the target Asset in the Token search if necessary.
batchConvert.invalidTarget: Invalid destination: Asset. Expected: XLM or CODE:Issuer (G…).
batchConvert.invalidSlippage: The slippage must be between 0 and 50%.
batchConvert.targetNotAuthorized: Your Trustline for {{code}} has not been approved by the publisher; it cannot be converted to this Asset.
batchConvert.targetAuthRequired: The editor of {{code}} requires that new Trustlines be approved. Create the Trustline first and have it approved.
batchConvert.previewFailed: The preview could not be loaded: {{reason}}
batchConvert.targetTrustlineNote: A Trustline will be created for {{code}} and retained (0.5 XLM reserve).
batchConvert.tempTrustlineNote: For Token without Trustline, this is created briefly and then immediately deleted. This requires a temporary reserve of 0.5 XLM.
batchConvert.insufficientReserve: Insufficient XLM available: {{needed}} XLM required (reserve and fees), {{available}} XLM available.
batchConvert.jobFirstChunkOnly: Only the first transaction with {{count}} entries is prepared as a Multisig job. Then run Batch-Convert again for the rest.
batchConvert.jobHint: Rates and Claimable Balances may change until everyone has signed. If the proceeds are then below the minimum amount or if a Claimable Balance is no longer present, the job fails. If it fails in the ledger, the fee is forfeited; otherwise, nothing changes.
batchConvert.jobTooLittleTime: At least one Claimable Balance is set to expire too soon for a Multisig job. Either deselect it or terminate it immediately.
batchConvert.stoppedNote: The process was aborted due to an error. Confirmed transactions are valid. A failed transaction has not changed anything except for the fee. If the outcome is unclear, check the hash in the explorer before restarting Batch-Convert.
batchConvert.selectTrustline: Please select a Trustline as the target Asset.
batchConvert.txAmbiguous: Transaction {{index}} with {{count}} entries: Result unclear (Netzwerkfehler). Please check hash {{hash}} in the explorer.
batchConvert.changedSincePreview: Something has changed since the preview (account, Trustlines, or Claimable Balances). Please reload the preview.
batchConvert.previewTooOld: The preview is more than 2 minutes old. Please reload the page so that the prices are up to date.
batchConvert.jobCreated: The job has been created. To add more entries, restart the Batch-Convert process afterward.
batchConvert.slippageHigh: With {{value}}% slippage, you may receive significantly less than what is shown in the preview.
batchConvert.targetOwnAsset: The target Asset is issued from your own account. No conversion is possible for this.
batchConvert.targetLimit: The expected revenue exceeds your Trustline limit for {{code}}. Increase the limit or select fewer entries.
